name: video_modify
description: Edit existing footage from a prompt (restyle, replace, add or remove elements) while keeping the motion. Pick a `slug` with `video_modify_models_list`; omit it for auto. Then `creations_show`.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video identifier. Exactly one of this or `videoUrl`.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

prompt.description: What to change in the footage. Describe the edit, not the whole scene.

resolution.description: Output resolution; the selectable set depends on the model.

slug.description: Catalog model slug from `video_modify_models_list`. Omit for auto-select.

targetAspectRatio.description: Aleph 2 only: re-frames the output. Omit to keep the source ratio.

videoUrl.description: Freepik video URL. Exactly one of this or `creationIdentifier`.
